cards.why: Runs a programmatic ad-buying platform. Its finance seat has turned over three times in under a year — a CFO out after six months, an interim, and now a permanent hire in Nate Olmstead as of July — and the latest quarter missed estimates by 8%, with shares down 24% since, while revenue has kept growing.
